name: Marble House
source:
A weekend at an exclusive men’s spa, Marble House, goes awry when a gruesome discovery is made.
Your old college friend Miles is getting married to his fiancé, Russell. You have been invited to the bachelor party. However, an unexpected snowstorm forces you to take shelter with a killer…

Your party of eligible bachelors is in for a wild weekend, starting with an indulgent first night…most of which you can’t seem to remember. Could your memories hold the key to unlocking the mystery?
